definitions.explanation: Pain in the lower abdomen or back that comes with menstruation. The everyday word; doctors call severe cases {月経困難症|げっけいこんなんしょう}.

examples.japanese: {生理痛|せいりつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧。
{生理痛|せいりつう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}んだ→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I stayed home from school because of period pain.

examples.japanese: {生理痛|せいりつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{我慢|がまん}しない→我慢する：25343_gamansuru⟧で⟦{痛|いた}み{止|ど}め→痛み止め：23497_itamidome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: When your period pain is severe, you should take a painkiller instead of putting up with it.

notes:
⟦{生理|せいり}→生理：31752_seiri⟧ (period) + {痛|つう} (pain, as in ⟦{頭痛|ずつう}→頭痛：03369_zutsuu⟧ and ⟦{腹痛|ふくつう}→腹痛：05019_fukutsuu⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {生理痛|せいりつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ひどい→ひどい：01097_hidoi⟧ / ⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧: to have bad period pain
- {生理痛|せいりつう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{軽|かる}い→軽い：00785_karui⟧: to have mild period pain
- {生理痛|せいりつう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧: medicine for period pain
- {生理休暇|せいりきゅうか}: menstrual leave, a right under Japanese labor law
